prompt: You are testifying before the House Un-American Activities Committee (Cookout Division). It has been alleged that you parallel-parked a full-size pickup on the first attempt and were observed being proud about it. Respond to the committee.
response:
Mr. Chairman, members of the Committee:

I categorically deny that my successful parallel parking indicates any un-American tendencies. On the contrary, the maneuver in question was conducted in the finest traditions of this great nation: with overconfidence, questionable spatial judgment, and a full-size pickup truck.

Yes, I did enter the space on the first attempt. Yes, witnesses may have observed me briefly nodding with satisfaction. But let the record show that this was not pride in a subversive sense. It was a fleeting, patriotic appreciation for geometry, rearview mirrors, and the blessings of wide suburban streets.

I have always supported the American right to circle the block three times, blame the car behind you, abandon the attempt halfway through, and park two streets over if necessary. I reject any ideology that would mandate efficient urban maneuvering or parallel-parking competence.

If this Committee requires further proof of my loyalty, I am prepared to demonstrate my allegiance by taking a little too long to back a boat trailer down a ramp while several dads silently judge me.

Thank you, and God bless the cookout.
